settings.section.models_dir_hint: Local model weights are stored here (one subfolder per backend). Leave empty for MayaAgentModels next to the project. Never auto-downloads. When changing path, you can migrate existing files.
settings.migrate_fail:
Migration incomplete: {error}
The new path will still be saved.
settings.migrate_partial: Moved {moved} item(s); skipped {skipped} due to name conflicts (still in the old folder).
settings.section.local_runtime_hint: Isolated CUDA process (not mayapy). One-click install sets up the env + torch only — not weights.
settings.local_enabled_hint: When off, no local_* tools are exposed to the Agent
settings.section.local_models_hint: Manual download only. Undownloaded backends are hidden from the Agent.
help.settings.local: Model → Local Models: install/start Runtime and download weights; Settings → Model files directory sets the storage path.
settings.reset_tip: Reset UI and Agent settings to defaults; API keys are kept
settings.reset_ui_tip: Reset language, font, UI scale, and temp directory to factory defaults
settings.reset_ui_body:
Reset settings to factory defaults?

· Language, font, UI scale, and temp directory will reset
· Model and Agent settings are not affected
settings.reset_body:
Reset settings to factory defaults?

· Model / Agent / Interface settings will reset
· API keys will not be deleted
settings.section.connection_hint: Choose a provider and enter an API key. Base URL usually needs no change.
settings.vision_tip:
Auto: detect vision from model name (gpt-4o, Claude, Gemini, or names containing vision / vl).
For custom endpoints, set On if detection fails.
settings.section.meshy_hint: Text/Image to 3D, remesh, rigging, and more. Create an API key in the Meshy Developer Platform (Bearer msy_…).
settings.meshy_enabled_hint: When off, Meshy tool calls return an error
settings.section.adv_hint: Set the ADV root folder (contains AdvancedSkeleton.mel). When found, the Agent exposes adv_* tools for one-click / stepwise rigging.
settings.adv_path_tip: Folder must contain AdvancedSkeleton.mel. Or set ADVANCED_SKELETON_PATH. Leave empty to auto-search common locations.
settings.adv_detect_fail: AdvancedSkeleton.mel not found — check the path
settings.section.gen_hint: Affects reply style and length. Prefer a lower Temperature for Agent tasks. Max Tokens is shared across providers; some caps (e.g. Qwen) are around 8192.
settings.max_tokens_tip:
Max output tokens per reply.
Limits differ by provider. If you see InvalidParameter / max_tokens range, lower this value.
settings.section.behavior_hint: Control how the Agent runs and what the UI shows.
settings.auto_undo_hint: Merge scene edits from one reply so they can be undone together
settings.confirm_destructive_hint: Ask before delete / clear and similar actions
settings.stream_hint: Show the reply as it generates
settings.show_thinking_hint: For reasoning models, show the thinking process before the reply
settings.show_tools_hint: Show tool names and result summaries in chat
settings.section.limits_hint: Avoid too many tool rounds in a single task.
settings.section.language_hint: Change the panel language. The panel reopens automatically to apply it fully.
settings.section.appearance_hint: Font and overall UI scale. Some widgets need a reopen to fully update.
settings.section.temp_dir_hint: Chat images, file-tool temps, Meshy downloads, viewport captures, and untitled sessions go here. Leave blank to use MayaAgentTempFile next to MayaAgent. When changing path, you can migrate existing files.
settings.ui_scale_tip: Scale fonts, buttons, and spacing (100% = default)
tools.hint: Double-click a tool name to insert it into the chat input.
help.blurb: An AI assistant for Maya game pipelines. Drive modeling, UVs, rigging, animation, materials, lighting, and export with natural language. Works with major LLMs; Maya 2020–2026 (PySide2 / PySide6).
help.quick.title: Quick start
help.quick.hint: Follow these steps the first time you use Maya Agent.
help.quick.1: Open Maya Agent → Open Panel, or click the Agent shelf button
help.quick.2: Under Model → LLM, pick a provider, enter an API key, and Test connection (changes autosave)
help.quick.3: Switch to Chat and describe a task in natural language, or expand Quick commands
help.quick.4: The Agent calls tools to edit the scene; destructive ops ask first; use Ctrl+Z to undo
help.chat.title: Chat
help.chat.hint: Sessions, input, quick actions, and feedback.
help.chat.1: Sessions: new / rename / delete / switch; multiple chats per scene
help.chat.2: Sessions autosave next to the scene (sidecar *.mayaagent.json); untitled scenes store locally until save
help.chat.3: Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline; the same button turns red Stop while busy
help.chat.4: Vision models: use +, drag files, or Ctrl+V paste; text-only models disable attach
help.chat.5: Clear only wipes the current chat memory, not the Maya scene
help.chat.6: Auto undo chunk merges one turn of edits for a single Ctrl+Z
help.chat.7: Quick commands expand chips under the composer (scene info, mesh stats, FBX, lights, …)
help.chat.8: Vision models can capture viewports and fetch reference images; text models can still search the web
help.chat.9: When intent is unclear, the assistant shows clickable choice buttons
help.settings.title: Model
help.settings.hint: Configure model and Agent behavior here. Changes autosave; Reset defaults anytime. Language, appearance, and temp directory are on the Settings tab.
help.settings.1: LLM: provider, model, API key, Base URL, image input, Temperature, Max Tokens; Test connection
help.settings.2: The LLM tab also has Agent behavior: auto undo, confirm destructive, streaming, show thinking/tools, max tool rounds
help.settings.meshy: Meshy: dedicated tab for enable toggle and API key, with a connection/balance test
help.settings.3: Language, font, UI scale, and temp directory live on the top-level Settings tab
help.settings.4: Reset defaults restores factory values but keeps saved API keys (including Meshy)
help.ui.title: Settings
help.ui.hint: Panel language, font, scale, and temporary files directory. Changes autosave.
help.ui.1: Language: the panel reopens automatically to apply it fully
help.ui.2: Appearance: font and UI scale; some widgets need a reopen to fully update
help.tools.title: Built-in tools
help.tools.hint: Describe tasks in natural language, or double-click a tool in the Tools tab.
